A '''soil and water analyzer''' was a device capable of scanning and analyzing the content of soil and [[Water/Legends|water]]. They were carried by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] specializing in [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] duties to make sure the water and earth in unfamiliar territory was safe.
